acceptance_algorithm: Load selected source certificate for the Qa/SU3 branch.
Load finite bases for F1..F5, G1..G5, and P, or an explicit cochain complex whose cohomology bases select them.
Compute product tables m_i: F_i x G_i -> P and extract mu_i in the selected bases.
Read f and g map entries in those same bases and verify g*f=0.
Independently load D_E/dotD/rho_E, projectors, and Green/Riesz data from the same source.
Verify source vectors s_i=Q dotD psi_i, responses dotPsi_i=-R s_i, and A dotPsi_i+s_i=0.
Run Freed-Witten, Green-Schwarz/Bianchi, stability/local-freeness, and projector-retention checks.

bridge_checks.name: same_source_identifier
bridge_checks.reason: The product tables and D_E/dotD response must be from the same branch.

bridge_checks.formula_or_check: B^{-1} m_i B and B^{-1} D_E B agree
bridge_checks.name: same_selected_bases_or_explicit_change_of_basis
bridge_checks.reason: Cochain and operator coordinates must be comparable.

bridge_checks.name: same_gf_zero_packet
bridge_checks.reason: The selected entries must satisfy the already-derived monad equation.

bridge_checks.name: admissibility_retention
bridge_checks.reason: A finite packet must remain admissible after selection.

decision.next_move: Attempt an actual selected finite source solve: either construct the cochain product tables first, or derive D_E/dotD and back out the same packet entries.
decision.result: Two-lane acceptance gate built; selected source data remain open.
decision.why: The finite cochain lane can select mu_i and f,g, while the operator lane can independently select D_E/dotD response. Closure requires both to agree or one to imply the other with an explicit bridge.

finite_cochain_lane.name: selected_finite_basis_for_each_space
finite_cochain_lane.reason: Without selected bases, product coefficients are coordinate choices.

finite_cochain_lane.name: selected_differentials
finite_cochain_lane.reason: Cech/Dolbeault matrices must form an actual finite complex.

finite_cochain_lane.name: selected_product_tables
finite_cochain_lane.reason: The coefficients mu_i must be read from product tables, not assigned.

finite_cochain_lane.name: selected_map_entries
finite_cochain_lane.reason: The monad maps must be entries in the same selected bases.

finite_cochain_lane.name: post_selection_monad_check
finite_cochain_lane.reason: Only after selection may g*f=0 be tested as a proof condition.

operator_response_lane.name: selected_DE_or_stiffness_operator
operator_response_lane.reason: A nontrivial operator must replace identity rho_E or diagonal phase fixtures.

operator_response_lane.formula_or_check: P^2=P, Q=I-P, A R Q = Q
operator_response_lane.name: selected_projectors_and_green_operator
operator_response_lane.reason: The response must live on the horizontal complement.

operator_response_lane.name: selected_dotD
operator_response_lane.reason: The source vectors cannot be texture knobs.

operator_response_lane.name: horizontal_response
operator_response_lane.reason: The linearized zero-mode response must be derived.

operator_response_lane.formula_or_check: A dotPsi_i + s_i = 0 and P dotPsi_i = 0
operator_response_lane.name: first_order_equation
operator_response_lane.reason: The operator response must satisfy the finite equations.
